target: Original c1 periodic saturated nu_b with sharpened analytically admissible amplitude; weak-normalized exact positive future-union D versus pair and signed obstacle term.
full_dimension_phase_map: theta1=sum first n/2 coordinates, theta2=sum last n/2 coordinates, modulo 2pi. Haar pushforward is uniform two-phase measure; every coordinate still has the original g1(xi^2) multiplier.
coordinate_symbol: g1(v)=log(1+v)/v, with g1(0)=1; no reset/discrete-Laplacian substitution
parameter_nodes: r_j=(j/J)^2, j=0..J; nested grids. Grid max is NOT continuous exact max.
packet_profile: Product over two phases of max(1-(2*wrapped_distance/width)^2,0)^3. Positive complete fixed mixture U, no layer-specific source budget.
saturated_source: C0=101/100, A=35*kappa/(8*C0*n*D_eff); for each positive product packet Gb<=L=C0*16*delta/35<=1 and bilinear corners give -SU<=n*L/2; positive mixture gives Su>=-kappa. Thus nu_b=(Su+kappa)1_Omega>=0 and mu_b=kappa1_Omega-Su1_Omega_complement<=kappa. Not output-based lambda retuning.
mechanism_provenance: Read lower-bound total table B41 shared full-source resolution mixture and B62 continuous shared concentric-scale mixture. These inputs use finite positive multiresolution/nested support mechanisms, not the full B41 lattice qualification or full continuous B62 family; the phase-correlated construction is separately declared.
receiver_rule: A={Omega_complement:M_grid>alpha*kappa}, smallest-index argmax label A_j. Main g_j=(alpha*kappa/M_grid)*1_Aj, so capped traffic equals alpha*kappa*receiver volume. Uncapped a_j=1_Aj recorded only as stronger comparison.
D_method: Positive future-union recursion c_j=q_j+(1-q_j)V c_{j+1}, d_j=V d_{j+1}+q_j V c_{j+1}; Cstop=P1 c1,Cdef=P1 d1. Also save survival and direct source-weighted future-union scalar for independent identity checks, plus future occupancy recursion for pair upper. O(J) convolution steps, no source-cone receiver sampling or Monte Carlo.
signed_obstacle_diagnostic: For each capped/uncapped record save mu_b*Cdef and u*S*Cdef integrals separately and check D=sum of these via independent S action. In particular alpha=2 enables cap-part absorption but signed potential is not assumed nonnegative or paid.
kernel_screens: Save min inverse-FFT coordinate Gi/P/increment kernels and mass error; do not clip negative kernels or probability fields. Floating screens are not interval certificates.
ambiguity: Threshold and top-two response margins <=1e-10*(1+abs response) counted and retained; actual strict float comparison/tie rule used, no adaptive threshold change.
saved_reconstruction: Source arrays U/u/nu_b/mu_b/Omega, source hashes, q/P symbols, r nodes, receiver winner labels and g weight, survival/D/pair/stop columns, main/uncapped scalars. Scripts reject any existing result filename.
limitations: Periodic normalized Lebesgue receivers, not source-weighted receiver sampling
Original Fourier-symbol cyclic discretization and FFT nonlinear aliasing, no interval certification

Rn truncation reconstructs a different saturated source from truncated u; source boundary error is analytic, while actual receiver winner migration requires threshold/tie margin and is not certified here

budget: 81 main records, 2 additional fixed-input spatial stability records; 2D closed original-symbol phase model, not an exponential n-dimensional grid. Expected 1-3 minutes, peak memory under 250MB.
randomness: None; deterministic quadrature and receiver grids. Common fixed source across parameter-node variants. No validation-set tuning.
adaptive_relation_to_prior_run: Input amplitude strengthened after the completely empty registered pilot; fixed alpha/kappa/r/widths/weights remain unchanged. This is adaptive exploratory input revision, not independent validation; preserve the entire prior result.
continuous_constant_certificate: w(t)<=exp(-abs t), periodized sup<=coth(pi); pi>3 and e>8/3 imply e^(2pi)>(8/3)^6>201, hence coth(pi)<101/100. Profile integral is exactly 16*delta/35, and all widths<=1.
